name: Wagon
overview: The biblical references to wagons highlight their practical and providential role in God's provision and the service of His people. In Genesis, wagons were sent from Egypt to transport Jacob and his family, symbolizing God's care in preserving His covenant family (Genesis 45:19, 27). In Numbers, wagons were dedicated by the princes as offerings and entrusted to the Levites to assist in the service of the tabernacle, demonstrating their importance in the worship and communal life of Israel (Numbers 7:3-6). These passages reveal how God orchestrates both physical means and sacred service to fulfill His purposes.
